limitations: Probe stages are inclusive; do not sum them. PNG proxy is not the runtime encoder.
All noisy samples are retained. Unrelated phase variance is observed; its cause was not established.
One-thread 1536/64 MiB is a constrained simulation, not a physical low-RAM machine.
User confirmed mouse scrolling during the interrupted app benchmark. It changed the measured page and cancelled in-flight renders. This is not evidence of an engine unsupported error.
App smoke passed 2/2 validity/pixel gates, but one pair is not a latency distribution.
The interrupted 60-run report is incomplete (10 valid of 11 observed). No P95 or whole-app speedup is claimed.
Corpus coverage, architecture milestones and release/installed smoke remain open. No installer was built.
FSP/FCVF chỉ tương quan PPE fulfilled phát sinh sau trigger với LiveTile theo path/trang/DPI/xoay/clip và độ phủ viewport; compositor chưa phát request ID của surface.

Report này chỉ đo trang chính khi thumbnail đóng; không phải baseline thumbnail.
